all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n4\t\n5\t**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n6\t\n7\t---\n8\t\n9\t## Receiver Session State Machine\n10\t\n11\t### States Overview\n12\t\n13\tThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n14\t\n15\t```\n16\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n17\t│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n18\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n19\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n20\t│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n21\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n22\t\n23\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n24\t│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n25\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n26\t│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n27\t│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n28\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n29\t\n30\t┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n31\t│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n32\t│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n33\t│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n34\t│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n35\t│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n36\t│                                                                  │\n37\t│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n38\t│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n39\t│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n40\t└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n41\t```\n42\t\n43\t### Detailed State Specifications\n44\t\n45\t#### 1. IDLE\n46\t**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n47\t**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n48\t\n49\t**Characteristics:**\n50\t- No session state persisted\n51\t- No camera active\n52\t- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n53\t\n54\t**Invariants:**\n55\t- `streamId === null`\n56\t- `meta === null`\n57\t- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n58\t\n59\t---\n60\t\n61\t#### 2. ACQUIRING\n62\t**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n63\t**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n64\t\n65\t**Characteristics:**\n66\t- Camera active, frame loop running\n67\t- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n68\t- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n69\t- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n70\t\n71\t**State fields:**\n72\t```ts\n73\ttype AcquiringState = {\n74\t  type: 'acquiring',\n75\t  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n76\t  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n77\t  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n78\t}\n79\t```\n80\t\n81\t**Transitions:**\n82\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n83\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n84\t- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n85\t\n86\t**Invariants:**\n87\t- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n88\t- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n89\t\n90\t---\n91\t\n92\t#### 3. RECEIVING\n93\t**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n94\t**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n95\t\n96\t**Characteristics:**\n97\t- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n98\t- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n99\t- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n100\t- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n101\t\n102\t**State fields:**\n103\t```ts\n104\ttype ReceivingState = {\n105\t  type: 'receiving',\n106\t  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n107\t  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n108\t  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n109\t  active: {                           // current block being decoded\n110\t    blockIndex: number,\n111\t    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n112\t    rank: number,\n113\t    consecutiveHigher: number,        // count of consecutive packets with higher blockIndex\n114\t    switchThreshold: number          // N consecutive packets to trigger block switch (default 32)\n115\t  } | null,                           // null = between blocks\n116\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n117\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n118\t  stats: {\n119\t    fps: number,\n120\t    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n121\t    packetsPerSec: number,\n122\t    eta: number,\n123\t    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n124\t  }\n125\t}\n126\t```\n127\t\n128\t**Block-switch policy (bf-2t1k):**\n129\t- The receiver holds the current active block until: (1) block completion (rank === K), OR (2) N consecutive higher-index packets arrive (default N=32)\n130\t- This prevents discarding nearly-complete blocks when camera frames straddle sender block transitions\n131\t- See: `docs/notes/bf-2t1k-block-switch-policy.md`\n132\t\n133\t**Transitions:**\n134\t- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n135\t- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n136\t- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n137\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n138\t- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n139\t\n140\t**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n141\t- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n142\t- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n143\t- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n144\t\n145\t**Invariants:**\n146\t- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n147\t- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n148\t- Exactly one block GE-active at a time (I5)\n149\t- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n150\t\n151\t---\n152\t\n153\t#### 4. VERIFYING\n154\t**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n155\t**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n156\t\n157\t**Characteristics:**\n158\t- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n159\t- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n160\t- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n161\t\n162\t**State fields:**\n163\t```ts\n164\ttype VerifyingState = {\n165\t  type: 'verifying',\n166\t  streamId: number,\n167\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n168\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n169\t  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n170\t  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n171\t  verificationProgress: {\n172\t    verified: number,\n173\t    total: number,\n174\t    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n175\t  }\n176\t}\n177\t```\n178\t\n179\t**Transitions:**\n180\t- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n181\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n182\t- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n183\t\n184\t**Invariants:**\n185\t- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n186\t- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n187\t\n188\t---\n189\t\n190\t#### 5. COMPLETE\n191\t**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n192\t**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n193\t\n194\t**Characteristics:**\n195\t- File ready for export\n196\t- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n197\t\n198\t**State fields:**\n199\t```ts\n200\ttype CompleteState = {\n201\t  type: 'complete',\n202\t  streamId: number,\n203\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n204\t  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n205\t  outputSize: number,\n206\t  verified: boolean,\n207\t  compressed: boolean\n208\t}\n209\t```\n210\t\n211\t**Transitions:**\n212\t- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n213\t\n214\t**Invariants:**\n215\t- File exists in OPFS\n216\t- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n217\t\n218\t---\n219\t\n220\t#### 6. PAUSED\n221\t**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n222\t**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n223\t\n224\t**Characteristics:**\n225\t- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n226\t- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n227\t- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n228\t\n229\t**State fields:**\n230\t```ts\n231\ttype PausedState = {\n232\t  type: 'paused',\n233\t  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n234\t  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n235\t  pauseTime: number\n236\t}\n237\t```\n238\t\n239\t**Transitions:**\n240\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n241\t- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n242\t- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n243\t\n244\t**Invariants:**\n245\t- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n246\t- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n247\t- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n248\t\n249\t---\n250\t\n251\t#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n252\t**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n253\t**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n254\t\n255\t**Characteristics:**\n256\t- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n257\t- UI: Shows repair code input field\n258\t\n259\t**State fields:**\n260\t```ts\n261\ttype RepairWaitingState = {\n262\t  type: 'repair-waiting',\n263\t  streamId: number,\n264\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n265\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n266\t  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n267\t  repairCode: string | null\n268\t}\n269\t```\n270\t\n271\t**Transitions:**\n272\t- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n273\t- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n274\t\n275\t**Invariants:**\n276\t- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n277\t\n278\t---\n279\t\n280\t#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n281\t**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n282\t**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n283\t\n284\t**Characteristics:**\n285\t- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n286\t- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n287\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n288\t\n289\t**State fields:**\n290\t```ts\n291\ttype RepairTransferringState = {\n292\t  type: 'repair-transferring',\n293\t  streamId: number,\n294\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n295\t  complete: Uint8Array,\n296\t  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n297\t  receivedCount: number\n298\t}\n299\t```\n300\t\n301\t**Transitions:**\n302\t- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n303\t- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n304\t\n305\t**Invariants:**\n306\t- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n307\t- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n308\t\n309\t---\n310\t\n311\t#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n312\t**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n313\t**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n314\t\n315\t**Characteristics:**\n316\t- Transfer cannot continue\n317\t- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n318\t- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n319\t\n320\t**State fields:**\n321\t```ts\n322\ttype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n323\t  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n324\t  streamId: number,\n325\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n326\t  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n327\t  partialOutputPath: string,\n328\t  missingBlocks: number[]\n329\t}\n330\t```\n331\t\n332\t**Transitions:**\n333\t- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n334\t\n335\t**Invariants:**\n336\t- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n337\t- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n338\t- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n339\t\n340\t---\n341\t\n342\t#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n343\t**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n344\t**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n345\t\n346\t**Characteristics:**\n347\t- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n348\t- Compressed artefact is kept\n349\t- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n350\t\n351\t**State fields:**\n352\t```ts\n353\ttype DecompressFailedState = {\n354\t  type: 'decompress-failed',\n355\t  streamId: number,\n356\t  meta: BeaconMeta,\n357\t  compressedOutputPath: string,\n358\t  error: string\n359\t}\n360\t```\n361\t\n362\t**Transitions:**\n363\t- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n364\t\n365\t**Invariants:**\n366\t- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n367\t- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n368\t- No data is lost\n369\t\n370\t---\n371\t\n372\t### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n373\t\n374\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n375\t|---|---|---|---|\n376\t| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n377\t| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n378\t| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n379\t| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n380\t| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n381\t| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n382\t| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n383\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n384\t| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n385\t| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n386\t| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n387\t| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n388\t| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n389\t| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n390\t| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n391\t| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n392\t| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n393\t| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n394\t\n395\t---\n396\t\n397\t## Sender Session State Machine\n398\t\n399\t### States Overview\n400\t\n401\tThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n402\t\n403\t```\n404\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n405\t│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n406\t│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n407\t│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n408\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n409\t\n410\t┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n411\t│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n412\t│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n413\t│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n414\t└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n415\t```\n416\t\n417\t### Detailed State Specifications\n418\t\n419\t#### 1. IDLE\n420\t**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n421\t**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n422\t\n423\t**Characteristics:**\n424\t- No file selected\n425\t- No active session\n426\t- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n427\t\n428\t**State fields:**\n429\t```ts\n430\ttype IdleState = {\n431\t  type: 'idle'\n432\t}\n433\t```\n434\t\n435\t---\n436\t\n437\t#### 2. SENDING\n438\t**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n439\t**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n440\t\n441\t**Characteristics:**\n442\t- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n443\t- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n444\t- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n445\t- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n446\t\n447\t**State fields:**\n448\t```ts\n449\ttype SendingState = {\n450\t  type: 'sending',\n451\t  source: File,\n452\t  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n453\t  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n454\t  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n455\t  blockCount: number,\n456\t  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n457\t  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n458\t  cursor: {\n459\t    blockIndex: number,\n460\t    seq: number                         // within block\n461\t  },\n462\t  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n463\t  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n464\t  sourceFingerprint: {\n465\t    size: number,\n466\t    lastModified: number\n467\t  }\n468\t}\n469\t```\n470\t\n471\t**Transitions:**\n472\t- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n473\t- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n474\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n475\t- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n476\t\n477\t**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n478\t- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n479\t- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n480\t- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n481\t\n482\t**Invariants:**\n483\t- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n484\t- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n485\t- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n486\t\n487\t---\n488\t\n489\t#### 3. PAUSED\n490\t**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n491\t**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n492\t\n493\t**Characteristics:**\n494\t- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n495\t- State preserved\n496\t- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n497\t\n498\t**State fields:**\n499\t```ts\n500\ttype PausedSenderState = {\n501\t  type: 'paused',\n502\t  previousState: SendingState,\n503\t  pauseTime: number\n504\t}\n505\t```\n506\t\n507\t**Transitions:**\n508\t- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n509\t\n510\t**Invariants:**\n511\t- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n512\t- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n513\t\n514\t---\n515\t\n516\t#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n517\t**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n518\t**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n519\t\n520\t**Characteristics:**\n521\t- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n522\t- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n523\t- UI: Shows repair progress\n524\t\n525\t**State fields:**\n526\t```ts\n527\ttype RepairModeState = {\n528\t  type: 'repair-mode',\n529\t  baseState: SendingState,\n530\t  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n531\t  emittedCount: number,\n532\t  totalTarget: number\n533\t}\n534\t```\n535\t\n536\t**Transitions:**\n537\t- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n538\t- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n539\t\n540\t**Invariants:**\n541\t- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n542\t- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n543\t\n544\t---\n545\t\n546\t#### 5. STOPPING\n547\t**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n548\t**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n549\t\n550\t**Characteristics:**\n551\t- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n552\t- Frame loop stopped\n553\t- Resources released\n554\t\n555\t**State fields:**\n556\t```ts\n557\ttype StoppingState = {\n558\t  type: 'stopping',\n559\t  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n560\t  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n561\t}\n562\t```\n563\t\n564\t**Transitions:**\n565\t- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n566\t\n567\t**Actions:**\n568\t- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n569\t- Close file handles\n570\t- Release camera/render resources\n571\t\n572\t---\n573\t\n574\t#### 6. COMPLETE\n575\t**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n576\t\n577\t---\n578\t\n579\t### Sender State Transitions Summary\n580\t\n581\t| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n582\t|---|---|---|---|\n583\t| IDLE | SENDING | User selects file, starts send | Compress (if enabled), derive streamId, start frame loop |\n584\t| SENDING | PAUSED | Tab backgrounded (E8) | Stop frame loop, preserve state |\n585\t| SENDING | REPAIR_MODE | Repair code entered | Restrict emission to target blocks |\n586\t| SENDING | STOPPING | User cancel / source changed (E5) | Begin graceful shutdown |\n587\t| SENDING | SENDING | Source change detected (E5) | Abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED |\n588\t| PAUSED | SENDING | Tab foregrounded | Resume frame loop |\n589\t| REPAIR_MODE | SENDING | Repair complete | Return to normal loop |\n590\t| REPAIR_MODE | STOPPING | User cancel | Begin shutdown |\n591\t| STOPPING | IDLE | Cleanup complete | Wipe staging, release resources |\n592\t\n593\t---\n594\t\n595\t## Implementation Guidelines\n596\t\n597\t### Replacing Nullable Fields\n598\t\n599\t**Current problematic pattern (plan.md §7.3):**\n600\t```ts\n601\ttype RecvSession = {\n602\t  streamId: number | null;      // ❌nullable\n603\t  meta: BeaconMeta | null;      // ❌nullable\n604\t  // ...\n605\t}\n606\t```\n607\t\n608\t**Replacement: Explicit Session State Machine Specification\n\n**Purpose:** Define all session states and transitions explicitly, replacing the nullable field approach (`streamId: number|null`, `meta: BeaconMeta|null`) that produces forgotten-transition bugs.\n\n**References:** plan.md §7.3, §7.6, §8.3, D22, D27, edge cases E8-E10, E12, E16\n\n---\n\n## Receiver Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe receiver has **10 primary states** grouped into three lifecycle phases:\n\n```\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ ACQUISITION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐            │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ ACQUIRING  │───▶  │ RECEIVING    │            │\n│  └─────────┘     └────────────┘     └──────────────┘            │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ COMPLETION PHASE                                               │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐     ┌───────────┐        │\n│  │ RECEIVING    │───▶  │ VERIFYING   │───▶  │ COMPLETE  │        │\n│  └──────────────┘     └─────────────┘     └───────────┘        │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│ RECOVERY & ERROR PHASE                                         │\n│  ┌──────────────┐     ┌──────────────────┐     ┌─────────────┐ │\n│  │ PAUSED       │     │ REPAIR_WAITING   │     │ QUOTA_...   │ │\n│  │              │◀───▶  │                  │     │ EXHAUSTED   │ │\n│  └──────────────┘     └──────────────────┘     └─────────────┘ │\n│                                                                  │\n│  ┌──────────────────────────────┐                               │\n│  │ DECOMPRESS_FAILED            │                               │\n│  └──────────────────────────────┘                               │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, session reset, or after export\n**Exit:** User starts camera (`getUserMedia`)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No session state persisted\n- No camera active\n- UI: Shows \"Start receiving\" or role selection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId === null`\n- `meta === null`\n- `complete === new Uint8Array(0)` (empty bitmap)\n\n---\n\n#### 2. ACQUIRING\n**Entry:** Camera started (`getUserMedia` success)\n**Exit:** First valid beacon received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Camera active, frame loop running\n- Headers being decoded, but filtered by `streamId === null`\n- UI: Shows \"acquiring...\" with live frame feedback\n- Stalls detected: optical diagnostics (`E-NO-SIGNAL`, `E-TOO-FAR`, etc.)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype AcquiringState = {\n  type: 'acquiring',\n  startTime: number,        // when camera started\n  frameCount: number,        // for stall detection\n  lastPacketTime: number,    // for optical stall detector\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Valid beacon arrives, `streamId` locked, `meta` parsed\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera permission revoked (E9) or camera track ends\n- **→ IDLE**: User cancels, camera error\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No packet routing occurs (no `streamId` to lock onto)\n- Beacon validation is **strict** (T1 bounds checking)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. RECEIVING\n**Entry:** First beacon parsed and accepted\n**Exit:** All blocks collected (bitmap all 1s)\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Normal operation: collecting blocks\n- GE decoder active on one block at a time (I5)\n- OPFS writes occur per completed block\n- UI: Progress bar, ETA, current rate\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype ReceivingState = {\n  type: 'receiving',\n  streamId: number,                    // locked, never changes\n  meta: BeaconMeta,                    // immutable after beacon\n  complete: Uint8Array,               // block bitmap\n  active: {                           // current block being decoded\n    blockIndex: number,\n    pivots: Map<number, GERow>,\n    rank: number,\n    consecutiveHigher: number,        // count of consecutive packets with higher blockIndex\n    switchThreshold: number          // N consecutive packets to trigger block switch (default 32)\n  } | null,                           // null = between blocks\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest | null,  // from §7.6\n  stats: {\n    fps: number,\n    cameraPxPerModule: number,\n    packetsPerSec: number,\n    eta: number,\n    dutyCycle: number,               // D27: 0.0–1.0\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Block-switch policy (bf-2t1k):**\n- The receiver holds the current active block until: (1) block completion (rank === K), OR (2) N consecutive higher-index packets arrive (default N=32)\n- This prevents discarding nearly-complete blocks when camera frames straddle sender block transitions\n- See: `docs/notes/bf-2t1k-block-switch-policy.md`\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: `bitmap.allSet()` && `manifest !== null`\n- **→ PAUSED**: Camera lost (E9), tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle (D27)\n- **→ QUOTA_EXHAUSTED**: OPFS write fails (E10)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: Decompression error after all blocks verified (E15)\n- **→ RECEIVING (self)**: Block hash fail (E12) → clear bitmap bit, re-collect\n\n**Sub-transitions within RECEIVING:**\n- **Block completion**: `rank === K` → verify hash → write OPFS → set bitmap bit → free matrix\n- **Block hash failure** (E12): Discard block, clear bitmap bit, restart collection\n- **Worker crash** (E16): Restart worker, discard only the active block, preserve bitmap\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `streamId` is **immutable** once locked (A9: wrong stream rejected)\n- `meta` is **immutable** (gates all decode parameters)\n- Exactly one block GE-active at a time (I5)\n- Block writes to OPFS are **atomic** (hash verification first)\n\n---\n\n#### 4. VERIFYING\n**Entry:** All blocks collected, manifest stream decoded\n**Exit:** All blocks verified against manifest hashes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- All blocks technically received, but retroactively verified\n- UI: Shows \"verifying...\" (not \"complete\" yet)\n- Occurs when manifest (blockIndex = 0xFFFFFF) decodes\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype VerifyingState = {\n  type: 'verifying',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // bitmap: all blocks marked received\n  out: FileSystemWritableFileStream,\n  manifest: BlockHashManifest,       // now decoded\n  verificationProgress: {\n    verified: number,\n    total: number,\n    failedBlocks: number[]          // blocks that failed hash\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ COMPLETE**: All blocks verified successfully\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Some blocks failed hash → clear those bits, re-collect (E12 extended)\n- **→ DECOMPRESS_FAILED**: All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- No OPFS writes occur during verification\n- Blocks are re-verified, not trusted (D22: resume MUST re-verify)\n\n---\n\n#### 5. COMPLETE\n**Entry:** All blocks verified and (if compressed) decompressed\n**Exit:** User exports file or app closes\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- File ready for export\n- UI: Shows \"Complete\" with export/share button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype CompleteState = {\n  type: 'complete',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  outputPath: string,                // OPFS file path\n  outputSize: number,\n  verified: boolean,\n  compressed: boolean\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Export successful, session cleared\n\n**Invariants:**\n- File exists in OPFS\n- Whole-file hash (if present) has been validated\n\n---\n\n#### 6. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Camera lost, tab backgrounded, or thermal duty-cycle\n**Exit:** Camera re-acquired, user resumes, or transfer abandoned\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Session state preserved (bitmap, meta)\n- Camera may be off or frame loop suspended\n- UI: Shows \"Paused\" with resume option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: ReceivingState,    // frozen state\n  pauseReason: 'camera-lost' | 'tab-backgrounded' | 'thermal',\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Camera re-acquired (user grants permission again)\n- **→ RECEIVING**: Tab foregrounded again (E8)\n- **→ IDLE**: User abandons transfer\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `bitmap` is preserved (no blocks lost)\n- `meta` and `streamId` unchanged\n- **No new packets are decoded** but progress is retained\n\n---\n\n#### 7. REPAIR_WAITING\n**Entry:** User invoked repair code flow (some blocks missing)\n**Exit:** Valid repair code entered\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer incomplete but user has chosen repair path\n- UI: Shows repair code input field\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairWaitingState = {\n  type: 'repair-waiting',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  missingBlocks: number[],          // derived from bitmap\n  repairCode: string | null\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ REPAIR_TRANSFERRING**: Valid repair code entered\n- **→ RECEIVING**: User cancels repair, returns to normal collection\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Bitmap is **not modified** during repair wait\n\n---\n\n#### 8. REPAIR_TRANSFERRING\n**Entry:** Valid repair code parsed\n**Exit:** All missing blocks received\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender is transmitting only the missing blocks\n- Receiver is in a special mode expecting only those blocks\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairTransferringState = {\n  type: 'repair-transferring',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,\n  expectedBlocks: Set<number>,       // only these blocks accepted\n  receivedCount: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ VERIFYING**: All expected blocks received\n- **→ REPAIR_WAITING**: Some blocks still missing after timeout\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only packets in the expected set are accepted**\n- Other packets are logged but discarded (E-FOREIGN-STREAM)\n\n---\n\n#### 9. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED\n**Entry:** OPFS quota check fails during RECEIVING (E10)\n**Exit:** Partial file exported or user clears space\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Transfer cannot continue\n- Partial file is kept (follows T4b lifecycle)\n- UI: Shows quota exhausted with partial export option\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype QuotaExhaustedState = {\n  type: 'quota-exhausted',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  complete: Uint8Array,              // partial bitmap\n  partialOutputPath: string,\n  missingBlocks: number[]\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Partial file exported, session ends\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **No silent truncation** (E10)\n- User is warned before keeping partial artefact\n- Partial file follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n\n---\n\n#### 10. DECOMPRESS_FAILED\n**Entry:** All blocks verified, but decompression fails (E15)\n**Exit:** User handles failure or keeps raw artefact\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Blocks verified, but gzip stream invalid\n- Compressed artefact is kept\n- UI: Shows decompression failed, keeps raw data\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype DecompressFailedState = {\n  type: 'decompress-failed',\n  streamId: number,\n  meta: BeaconMeta,\n  compressedOutputPath: string,\n  error: string\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: User acknowledges, raw artefact kept\n\n**Invariants:**\n- Raw (compressed) artefact is preserved\n- Follows T4b deletion lifecycle\n- No data is lost\n\n---\n\n### Receiver State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | ACQUIRING | User starts camera | `getUserMedia()` |\n| ACQUIRING | RECEIVING | First valid beacon | Lock streamId, parse meta |\n| ACQUIRING | PAUSED | Camera lost | Preserve state, await re-grant |\n| ACQUIRING | IDLE | User cancels / error | Release camera |\n| RECEIVING | VERIFYING | All blocks collected, manifest decoded | Begin hash verification |\n| RECEIVING | PAUSED | Camera lost / thermal | Preserve state |\n| RECEIVING | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | OPFS quota exhausted (E10) | Stop, export partial |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Block hash fail (E12) | Clear bitmap bit, re-collect |\n| RECEIVING | RECEIVING | Worker crash (E16) | Restart worker, discard active block |\n| VERIFYING | COMPLETE | All blocks verified | Prepare export |\n| VERIFYING | RECEIVING | Some blocks failed hash | Clear failed bits, re-collect |\n| VERIFYING | DECOMPRESS_FAILED | Decompression error (E15) | Keep compressed artefact |\n| PAUSED | RECEIVING | Camera re-acquired / foregrounded | Resume with preserved state |\n| PAUSED | IDLE | User abandons | Clear session |\n| REPAIR_WAITING | REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | Valid repair code entered | Accept only expected blocks |\n| REPAIR_TRANSFERRING | VERIFYING | All expected blocks received | Verify and complete |\n| QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | IDLE | Partial export complete | Clear session, warn user |\n| DECOMPRESS_FAILED | IDLE | User acknowledges | Keep artefact, clear session |\n\n---\n\n## Sender Session State Machine\n\n### States Overview\n\nThe sender has **6 primary states**:\n\n```\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────┐     ┌──────────┐     ┌─────────────┐      │\n│  │ IDLE    │───▶  │ SENDING  │───▶  │ PAUSED      │      │\n│  └─────────┘     └──────────┘     └─────────────┘      │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n\n┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│  ┌─────────────┐     ┌──────────────┐     ┌─────────┐  │\n│  │ REPAIR_MODE │───▶  │ STOPPING     │───▶  │ IDLE    │  │\n│  └─────────────┘     └──────────────┘     └─────────┘  │\n└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\n### Detailed State Specifications\n\n#### 1. IDLE\n**Entry:** App initialization, transfer complete, or cancel\n**Exit:** User selects file and starts sending\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- No file selected\n- No active session\n- UI: Shows \"Send file\" button\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype IdleState = {\n  type: 'idle'\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n#### 2. SENDING\n**Entry:** File selected, compression (if enabled) complete, first frame rendered\n**Exit:** User stops, tab backgrounded, or file change detected\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Frame loop running at ≤½ measured camera fps (D9)\n- Blocks emitted cyclically with dwell (§8.1)\n- Beacons emitted every ~2 seconds (D17)\n- Stateless sender: frame N generated on-demand without replaying 1…N−1 (D24)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype SendingState = {\n  type: 'sending',\n  source: File,\n  staging: FileSystemFileHandle | null,  // compressed copy (D8), wiped on complete\n  streamId: number,                      // derived §7.4\n  blockSize: number,                   // 192 KB\n  blockCount: number,\n  readonly fragmentLen: number,         // L (I1: immutable)\n  readonly K: number,                   // D26\n  cursor: {\n    blockIndex: number,\n    seq: number                         // within block\n  },\n  dwellPackets: number,                 // §8.1: 1.6K default\n  lastFrameEmitted: number,\n  sourceFingerprint: {\n    size: number,\n    lastModified: number\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ PAUSED**: Tab backgrounded (E8, visibilitychange)\n- **→ REPAIR_MODE**: User enters repair code from receiver\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels, file changed (E5), or staging error\n- **→ SENDING (self)**: Source file change detected (E5) → abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED\n\n**Sub-transitions within SENDING:**\n- **Frame loop**: Generate frame → render → sleep to meet fps target → repeat\n- **Beacon emission**: Every ~2 seconds, emit beacon at conservative profile\n- **Source change detection** (E5): Re-check `file.size` and `lastModified` before each block read\n\n**Invariants:**\n- `L` is **immutable** (I1)\n- Frames are generated on-demand, never pre-rendered (I7)\n- Ring buffer depth ≤ 3 (I7)\n\n---\n\n#### 3. PAUSED\n**Entry:** Tab backgrounded (E8)\n**Exit:** Tab foregrounded\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- `rAF` stopped, frame loop suspended\n- State preserved\n- UI: Shows \"Sending paused — keep this tab visible\" (E-BACKGROUNDED)\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype PausedSenderState = {\n  type: 'paused',\n  previousState: SendingState,\n  pauseTime: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Tab foregrounded (visibilitychange)\n\n**Invariants:**\n- State unchanged, can resume seamlessly\n- **Wake Lock does not cover background tabs** (E8), so pause is necessary\n\n---\n\n#### 4. REPAIR_MODE\n**Entry:** User enters repair code from receiver\n**Exit:** Missing blocks sent\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Sender transmits **only** the blocks specified in repair code\n- Normal dwell and beacons still apply\n- UI: Shows repair progress\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype RepairModeState = {\n  type: 'repair-mode',\n  baseState: SendingState,\n  targetBlocks: Set<number>,           // only these blocks emitted\n  emittedCount: number,\n  totalTarget: number\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ SENDING**: Repair complete, return to normal loop\n- **→ STOPPING**: User cancels\n\n**Invariants:**\n- **Only blocks in target set are emitted**\n- Other block indices are skipped in the loop\n\n---\n\n#### 5. STOPPING\n**Entry:** User cancels or error condition\n**Exit:** Cleanup complete, back to IDLE\n\n**Characteristics:**\n- Graceful shutdown: wipe staging file (D8, T4a)\n- Frame loop stopped\n- Resources released\n\n**State fields:**\n```ts\ntype StoppingState = {\n  type: 'stopping',\n  reason: 'user-cancel' | 'source-changed' | 'error',\n  previousState: SendingState | RepairModeState\n}\n```\n\n**Transitions:**\n- **→ IDLE**: Cleanup complete\n\n**Actions:**\n- Wipe staging file (D8, T4a, E11)\n- Close file handles\n- Release camera/render resources\n\n---\n\n#### 6. COMPLETE\n**Note:** The sender has **no COMPLETE state**. The sender cannot know when the receiver is done (no back-channel). The sender loops forever until explicitly stopped.\n\n---\n\n### Sender State Transitions Summary\n\n| From State | To State | Trigger | Action |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| IDLE | SENDING | User selects file, starts send | Compress (if enabled), derive streamId, start frame loop |\n| SENDING | PAUSED | Tab backgrounded (E8) | Stop frame loop, preserve state |\n| SENDING | REPAIR_MODE | Repair code entered | Restrict emission to target blocks |\n| SENDING | STOPPING | User cancel / source changed (E5) | Begin graceful shutdown |\n| SENDING | SENDING | Source change detected (E5) | Abort with E-SOURCE-CHANGED |\n| PAUSED | SENDING | Tab foregrounded | Resume frame loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | SENDING | Repair complete | Return to normal loop |\n| REPAIR_MODE | STOPPING | User cancel | Begin shutdown |\n| STOPPING | IDLE | Cleanup complete | Wipe staging, release resources |\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Guidelines\n\n### Replacing Nullable Fields\n\n**Current problematic pattern (plan.md §7.3):**\n```ts\ntype RecvSession = {\n  streamId: number | null;      // ❌nullable\n  meta: BeaconMeta | null;      // ❌nullable\n  // ...\n}\n```\n\n**Replacement: Explicit states**\n```ts\ntype
